question: Can a few economically distinct signal-time mechanisms improve same-date allocation among the frozen current CHINEXT candidates?
honesty_boundary: The four bundles, two fixed model classes, input set, fitting schedule, target, and decision rules are frozen after HAB-CHX-RANK-INFO-001 and before any multivariate estimate is accepted. All 2018-2023 rows remain consumed development history.

candidate_contract.baseline: existing rs_score rank with mom60 then symbol tie break
candidate_contract.primary_domain: dates with at least two candidates and a complete executable 20-session outcome
candidate_contract.primary_action: select Top-1 within the contemporaneous candidate set
candidate_contract.secondary_action: Top-3 mean where at least four candidates exist
candidate_contract.outcome: next-open to 20th-session close total return net 10 bps per side

rank_inputs.transform: same-date oriented percentile rank computed only across candidates visible at the same decision_at

EQ_COMPRESSION_DEFENSE.mechanism: relative strength plus compressed structure and a less extended minimum-volume location

EQ_PATIENT_SUPPLY.mechanism: long-horizon relative strength without short-horizon acceleration and with supply dry-up

EQ_BREAKOUT_ACCEPTANCE.mechanism: relative strength confirmed by breakout participation while avoiding an extended minimum-volume location

EQ_BALANCED_FIVE.mechanism: balanced trend, compression, supply, and trigger confirmation

model_target: forward_return_20 clipped once at [-0.25, 0.50] to limit single-trade leverage on fit; unclipped returns used for evaluation

chronology.fit_rule: for score year Y, fit once on all complete candidates dated before January 1 of Y
chronology.selection: no hyperparameter, feature, threshold, or fold search

decision_rules.strong_candidate: higher Top-1 mean than baseline in both comparison blocks, no worse severe-loss rate in either, and at least 20 decisions per block
decision_rules.risk_candidate: severe-loss rate improves by at least five percentage points in both blocks without reducing mean by more than one percentage point in either
decision_rules.engine_replay_limit: replay no more than the strongest two candidates; one is preferred when evidence is close
decision_rules.failure: do not replay if no candidate passes either rule

prohibited: changing or retesting the frozen 0.20 RS-acceleration veto
future outcome, MFE, MAE, actual selection, or trade-return fields as predictors
feature, threshold, model, or hyperparameter search
claiming any block is untouched OOS
